title: The Keeper's Key's item description ('the pilgrims' stair at Coldpass, if the old talk holds') pointed to only one of its two actual uses; at Hollowbrook's Kings' Rest door I nearly spent it there out of fear I'd need a different key for Coldpass, only discovering the non-consuming verses alternative by exhausting dialogue options first.
